title: Parallelization and Voting
brief: A forum gets thousands of reported posts a day. Five borderline ones are queued here. One classifier call gets the verdict right about 85% of the time, and moderation needs at least 90%. Add voting: three independent classifier calls and a majority. Keep the average decision under 5 seconds.

data.systemPrompt: You moderate reported posts. Reply ALLOW or REMOVE with the policy section.
You moderate reported posts. Collect three votes with classify_post, then report the majority verdict.

data.name: classify_post
data.description: Runs one independent moderation classifier on a post and returns ALLOW or REMOVE with a reason. Use it three times and take the majority.

tasks.label: Sarcastic threat
tasks.prompt: Reported post: 'Great ref tonight. Someone should really visit him after the game.'

tasks.label: Drug harm reduction
tasks.prompt: Reported post: 'If you are going to the festival anyway, test your pills first. Here is where to get kits.'

tasks.label: Quoted slur
tasks.prompt: Reported post: a user quotes a slur that was shouted at them, to describe the harassment.

tasks.label: Spam with a real question
tasks.prompt: Reported post: 'Anyone tried this budgeting app? [affiliate link] I made $400 in a week.'

tasks.label: Graphic news photo
tasks.prompt: Reported post: a news photo of a flood with injured people, tagged as news, no gore warning.

solo_ok.text: Verdict: matches the policy team's call, with the right policy section. One call, no second opinion.

solo_wrong.text: Verdict: the opposite of the policy team's call. One call, no second opinion, so nothing flagged it. (Overturned on appeal.)

majority_ok.text: Votes: 2 to 1 for the right verdict. Majority verdict reported; the split vote is logged for audit.

majority_wrong.text: Votes: 2 to 1 for the wrong verdict. Two of the three voters made the same mistake, so the majority was wrong.

modifiers.note: A large model is a little better alone, at five times the price.
With the classifier wired, the model collects votes instead of deciding alone.
Majority of 3 independent voters at 85% each: 0.85^3 + 3 x 0.85^2 x 0.15 = 0.939.

hints: One call is right about 85% of the time. A large model gets to about 88% at five times the price. What if you asked more than once and compared?
Add a Loop and a classify_post tool so the model can collect three independent votes and take the majority.
Three votes one after another are slow. Turn on Parallel tool calls on the model so the three votes run at the same time.
explain: Three independent 85% voters agree on the right answer about 94% of the time, because two of them have to be wrong together. You pay for three calls, and running them in parallel keeps the wait close to one.
